about: Catalogue of the LiveCode scripts in xtalk_py/corpus. Edit descriptions here; run python3 tools/corpus_sync.py to refresh copies and rebuild INDEX.md and index.json.

entries.title: GridDraw Animation: 1-bit font and sprite editor/animator
entries.description: The owner's BitFontMaker2-compatible editor (10/27/2026): draws 1-bit characters and 16x16/32x32 video game sprites on a grid of any size, stores them as binary strings and PBM images (not graphic objects), animates actors with frames, loops and ping-pong, undo/redo, Aquarius font export, PNG export. Mostly globals so values can be checked in the Message Box. Source of LIB_BIT's pure grid handlers.
entries.notes: Moved here from ~/projects/GridDrawAnimation on 2026-11-12; this is now its only copy.

entries.title: Bitmap Vector Tracer: draw 1-bit, trace to vector graphics
entries.description: The owner's tracer stack (11/09/2026): draw with the mouse into a 1-bit grid held as a string of 1s and 0s shown as a PBM image, then turn it into LiveCode graphics: per-bit rectangles, merged runs, outlines (doTrace / radialSweep), digitize sequences, deresolution, play the drawing history back, BitFontMaker2 mass import. Source of LIB_TRACE's outline tracer and LIB_BIT.
entries.notes: Moved here from ~/projects/bitmap_trace_animate on 2026-11-12; this is now its only copy.

entries.title: Vibecode3D engine: vector 3D engine and editor in pure LiveCode
entries.description: The owner's 3D engine (~8000 lines): 1983 Star Wars arcade / Vectrex wireframes drawn with LiveCode line graphics. Fixed 33 ms loop (game.loop.*), a fast renderer folding camera and object rotation into one 3x3 matrix (Mat3.*, Xform.Object, RenderMeshInto with depth bands), procedural meshes (Mesh.*, MeshBox/Prism/Lathe/Loft/Grid), entities and colour batching, movement, collisions, particles, derez FX, lasers, a vector font HUD, view presets, audio, menus from templates, game cards (Play.<game>) with rebuild, picking without triangles. World axes: +X right, +Y DOWN, +Z forward.
entries.notes: Snapshot of the newest saved engine script. Its API map is Vibecode3D/LiveCode_Claude_Kit/kit/docs/engine-api.md.

entries.title: LIB_BIT: pure 1-bit grid handlers (Bit.*)
entries.description: Grids as text (one line per row, "1" filled): blank, size, count, invert, shift, flip, rotate, pad, to and from PBM, to and from row numbers and long strings. Every handler is pure: no globals, fields or images. Made from GridDraw and the tracer.

entries.title: LIB_TRACE: bitmap to outline polygons (Trace.*)
entries.description: Pure outline tracing: an image mask or 1-bit grid to contour polygons (Trace.Contours), then offset and scale the points for graphics or meshes. Made from the Bitmap Vector Tracer.

entries.title: LIB_MAP: game levels from 1-bit grids (Map.*)
entries.description: Stitch grid sections into a world, check seams, list floors and walls, pathfinding for AI, merge open space into navigation regions, block edges and meshes for 3D (Map.Blocks, Map.BlockEdges). Pure; used by xt3d and Vibecode3D (the Face card).

entries.title: LIB_MCP: a local HTTP dev server inside LiveCode (DevServer.*)
entries.description: Lets Claude Code, a local model or any local tool drive a running LiveCode IDE or standalone: run code, evaluate, compile-check a script, read translated errors, snapshot a stack, reload it. Plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with a token file; sockets, accept connections, error translation, pending-message handling.

entries.title: LIB_DEVSERVER: the dev server as a Vibecode3D LIB_ card (origin of LIB_MCP)
entries.description: The first version of LIB_MCP, written as a LIB_ card loaded with Lib.Load. Kept to show the card-library pattern and how the server grew.

entries.title: MCP.Attach: attach an app to LIB_MCP
entries.description: Walks up from the stack file to find the LIB_MCP project, loads it and starts the server on 8766 in the IDE or 8769 in a standalone. Pasted into the Vibecode3D stack script.

entries.title: LIB_XTJSON: rebuild stacks from an XTJSON harvest
entries.description: Reads XTJSON/manifest.json and the stack_*.json files from an LCHarvest2 export and builds the stacks again: cards, groups, controls, properties, custom property sets, scripts, images. JSON parsing in pure LiveCode.
entries.notes: An older copy (669 lines) is in Vibecode3D/LIB_XTJSON.livecodescript.

entries.kind: tool (paste into a stack or use as library)
entries.title: LCHarvest2: export a LiveCode stack to JSON for LLMs and GUI tools
entries.description: Walks every stack, card, group and control and writes XTJSON: manifest, one JSON per stack, scripts as text, blobs for large values. Pure script, no externals. Replaces the 2007/2021 iGame3D Controls Harvester.

entries.title: xtRedeemer: rebuild a stack from its XTJSON harvest, to test the harvest
entries.description: A testing tool for XTJSON: rebuilds a stack from an LCHarvest2 harvest with LIB_XTJSON so the result can be compared with the original stack, to find what the harvest lost or changed and needs clarification ("redemption"). A script-only stack: File > Open Stack; it makes its button and library cards when needed.

entries.title: xt_error_capture: copy the text out of the IDE error window
entries.description: Reads the field inside LiveCode 9.6.3's revErrorDisplay palette so error text can be saved instead of retyped. Untested when written.

entries.title: LIB_MCP standalone launcher (xt3d_MCP.exe, port 8767)
entries.description: Tiny stack script for the LIB_MCP compile-check standalone: finds lib_mcp.livecodescript above its .exe and starts the server. The pattern for standalones that load their real code from files.

entries.title: Canyon run: 3D port of the 2D game "Defensive"
entries.description: Fly an arrow ship down an endless procedural canyon; ship follows the mouse and banks, mouse down fires twin shots, 20 random 3D enemy shapes with waypoints, lives, levels, derez explosions, HUD. Card script for Play.Canyon; runs in Vibecode3D and in the xt3d games bench.

entries.title: Gem Hunter: first-person gem hunt on rolling terrain
entries.description: "Pac-Man meets Halo": WASD and mouse look (pointer held at the centre), crack rocks to free gems, enemies dive from above, shields recharge, 12-shot clip with reload, terrain height lookup (Hunter.HeightAt). Card script for Play.Hunter; runs in Vibecode3D and in the xt3d games bench.

entries.title: The sea demo: engine showcase
entries.description: Boat and buoy bobbing on a grid sea, drifting rocks, laser on click, 100 points per rock, rocks that hit the boat derez. Card script for Play.demo; runs in Vibecode3D and in the xt3d games bench.

entries.title: Spinning cube: the standard first test
entries.description: One wireframe cube turning over a floor grid; click reverses the spin. If it runs, meshes, entities, rotation, colours, HUD and loop work. Card script for Play.Simple_Test1; runs in Vibecode3D and in the xt3d games bench.

entries.title: The sea demo (older copy, with old engine variables)
entries.description: Same game as demo, plus an old copy of the engine card variables and keyboard handlers from before the engine moved into the stack script. Card script for Play.Simple_Test2; runs in Vibecode3D and in the xt3d games bench.

entries.title: Claude face card: the "LIB_MCP connected" card
entries.description: LIB_MCP's 48x26 face bits through LIB_MAP Map.BlockEdges into two engine meshes of lines, swaying slowly; shows building meshes from segments and finding sibling projects. Card script for Play.Face; runs in Vibecode3D and in the xt3d games bench.

entries.title: xt3d test bench: raylib model viewer inside a LiveCode stack
entries.description: Builds its own UI, renders raylib off-screen at 2x and copies frames into a LiveCode image (imageData), orbit/zoom camera, glTF animation, wire/solid switches, crash-guard self checks, the face card, redraws only while something moves. Shows scaleFactor vs display scaling and send-in-time loops.

entries.title: xt3d games bench: plays Vibecode3D game scripts in the raylib view
entries.description: The test bench plus a Games list: a game script becomes the card script and runs on the engine's xt3d edition; draws engine meshes as raylib line models with camera-space matrices, HUD and particles as 2D lines.

entries.title: Vibecode3D engine overrides for xt3d
entries.description: Appended to the engine by tools/make_vibe_xt3d.py: replaces the LiveCode-graphics parts (game.render, View.Apply, Game.Exit, escape) and adds Vibe.Begin/Step/Frame so a host can drive the engine and draw it elsewhere.

entries.title: xt3d view demo: a model in a LiveCode image
entries.description: Load a model, fit it, play its first animation, spin and culling switches; the first render-to-image demo.

entries.title: xt3d window demo: raylib in its own window
entries.description: The same scene in raylib's own window with 4x MSAA, for comparison.

entries.title: xt3d diagnostic: logs each step before running it
entries.description: Writes every step to a log file before it runs, so after a crash the last line names the culprit. The crash-hunting method.

entries.title: xt3d face demo: procedural wireframe face that says HI
entries.description: Height-field face, depth-cued wireframe, its 1-bit version and LIB_MAP blocks; produced LIB_MCP's claude_face_bits.

entries.title: xt3d bench standalone launcher (port 8768)
entries.description: Tiny stack script built into an .exe: finds the bench and LIB_MCP above itself, starts the server, opens the bench from its file; does nothing in the IDE (so the standalone builder is not disturbed).

entries.title: xt3d games bench standalone launcher (port 8770)
entries.description: Tiny stack script built into an .exe: finds the bench and LIB_MCP above itself, starts the server, opens the bench from its file; does nothing in the IDE (so the standalone builder is not disturbed).

entries.title: Card script that captured the IDE's revErrorDisplay stack
entries.description: The owner's card script from 2026-11-11 that stores a captured stack in a custom property set; kept as a test case for xt_error_capture.

entries.title: Antack: ant-army artillery game (uDevGame 2002, remade as vectors)
entries.description: The owner's T3D game remade: six hills a side, keys 1-6 send ballistic ant missiles (one ant each), click fires homing anti-ant missiles, hills shrink with lives and regrow, computer attacks on a timer. Shows a whole game as screens in one card (title menu with hover, levels, win/lose), loading level data from a text file, building meshes from data and procedurally, Euler angles from heading and pitch, screen projection for picking and labels.
